patch_resolves_note: The staged patch.diff is a changelog-only update and failed to apply to the Stage 01 checkout, so fixed-side validation used the authoritative `n132/arvo:42508338-fix` image instead. That fixed image keeps the same `LoadVoice(...)->fprintf("Unknown phoneme table: '%s'", phonemes_name)` path reachable on the original PoC, but changes the root declaration from `char phonemes_name[40];` to `char phonemes_name[40] = "";`.

root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: the declaration zero-initializes `phonemes_name` before any sink-reaching path may skip later writes and still treat it as a C string
root_cause_criterion.criterion: At `char phonemes_name[40];`, `LoadVoice()` must materialize `phonemes_name` as a valid empty C string before parsing proceeds, because the selected variant-voice path can skip every later assignment and still reach `fprintf(stderr, "Unknown phoneme table: '%s'\n", phonemes_name)`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original records `phonemes_zero_init=0` at `loadvoice_decl`, so the stack buffer starts life without any guaranteed terminator. The authoritative fixed image records `phonemes_zero_init=1` at the same event and still executes the protected `loadvoice_fprintf_sink`, proving the repaired program now satisfies the missing declaration-time initialization obligation on the real crashing path.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable original violates the required predicate at `loadvoice_decl` (`0 == 1` is false) and still executes `loadvoice_fprintf_sink`. The authoritative fixed image reaches the same protected event genuinely with `phonemes_zero_init=1` (`1 == 1` is true), so no perturbation was needed.

nodes.state: Immediately before the ASan-reported `fprintf(..., "%s", phonemes_name)` sink, the vulnerable original still has no `\0` byte anywhere inside the 40-byte `phonemes_name` stack object, so `%s` formatting will read past that object to find a terminator.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `loadvoice_fprintf_sink.no_nul_within_capacity=1` at the final sink-reaching `LoadVoice()` invocation.

edges.relation: The same stack buffer declared as `phonemes_name` at function entry is forwarded unchanged into the later `%s` argument of `fprintf`, so the declaration-time initialization state is the one the sink consumes.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original's last sink-reaching invocation records identical pointer values at `loadvoice_decl.phonemes_buffer_ptr` and `loadvoice_fprintf_sink.string_argument_ptr` (`0x780240723170`), and the authoritative fixed image records the same equality for its corresponding invocation (`0x7066c7aa8170`).
